thread:
rowan: Heads-up: planning a runtime image cascade next Tue 07:30 PT. Scope: drop legacy compression libs, rotate cosign key, and ensure audit events tie image SHA -> SBOM -> signature -> keyVersion. Need quick RBAC/KMS preflight.

pat: Proposal: 3-wave canary (5%/25%/100%) with automated SBOM+sig verification after each wave. Short windows (15m/25m/15m).

elis: On RBAC: signer SA needs kms.cryptoKeySigner; ops-verifier needs cloudkms.publicKeyViewer. Also attestor workflow must emit auditlog writes.

infra-bot: Minimal IAM delta (GCP style):
```
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> serviceAccount:runtime-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer -> serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

security-bot: CI scan shows allowlist drift for `libbrotli` on candidate image (warning): https://ci.internal/scan/31876

elis: I'll triage brotli against NVD and our internal DB. If no CVE, non-blocker; will attach SBOM diff. ETA 1.5h.

rowan: Ops requested an example audit event shape so telemetry can ingest the pairing. Minimal example: 
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:0f1e2d3c",
  "sbom_uri": "gs://sboms/sha256-0f1e2d3c.json",
  "signature_ref": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/k/cryptoKeys/cosign/signatures/abcd",
  "key_version": "7",
  "attestor": "projects/attest-prod/attestors/runtime",
  "deployed_by": "serviceAccount:ci-deployer",
  "ts": "2026-03-10T14:30:00Z"
}
```

oncall: Rollback playbook snippet (trigger: verification fail or >3% error):
```
# revert registry tag to previous sha
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy explicit digest
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha -n runtime
```

pat: Also add short-lived publicKeyViewer for 48h after rotation so older signatures still verify; drop Sign immediately after rotation.

elis: Triage update: brotli bump is a minor patch, no NVD CVEs. Marking non-blocker. SBOM diff uploaded to MR.

rowan: Action items: 1) @elis open infra MR for KMS role grants, 2) @pat add audit event sample to ops, 3) @oncall add rollback snippet to runbook and watch, 4) @infra-bot add cache invalidation step post-promote. Canary Tue 07:30 PT.

pat: MR opened: https://git.internal/infra/mr/9001 (tf + tests). Please review quickly.

rowan: If no objections we'll merge after two approvals and proceed. Thanks.
